class.name: CASLocalDirectoryBackend
class.brief_description: Shared import cache in a directory.
class.description: A [CASBackend] storing import results in a directory, for example on a network drive shared by a team. The editor uses one automatically when [code]editor/import/cas/shared_cache_directory[/code] is set in the editor settings.

method.name: set_writable
method.description: If [param writable] is [code]false[/code], import results are only read from the directory.

members.member: The directory where import results are stored.
